pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: scripts/db/backup.ts:45 These scripts take their only configuration as per-run CLI flags (--keep, --label, --dry-run, --from, --yes) plus the store path from pglitePath(), and they hold no settings store at all; a search of the tracked files under scripts/ for settings, getSetting, setSetting, preference and app_setting found nothing (the only hits were inside the gitignored scripts/db-bench/node_modules).

techniques.evidence: scripts/db/backup.ts:73 This rotates backups of the whole PGlite data store, not of an operator-owned settings file, so the technique's precondition (a local config file that is the only copy) does not apply here.
scripts/db/migrate.ts:29 Flags are read per invocation and nothing persists them, so there is no stored key space to register.
scripts/db/migrate.ts:32 There is one value from one source (an env var or a constant, resolved in lib/db/config, which is outside this context), not a configuration chain built from several sources.

pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: lib/db/pglite/repositories/weights.ts:1 The repositories store domain tables (kg nodes/edges, votes, changes, reviews, ledger, provenance and anonymous lens-weight submissions) with no application settings or preference key-value store; a search of the tracked repositories directory for settings, getSetting, setSetting, preference and app_setting found nothing.

techniques.evidence: lib/db/pglite/repositories/weights.ts:59 The table closest to a preference is an append-only log of anonymous weight-vector submissions that feeds a published aggregate. It is not a per-user setting keyed by name.
lib/db/pglite/repositories/weights.ts:52 This is a codec that validates submission data, not a typed accessor that returns a setting with a default.
